description: Move the pointer over an element and leave it there, to reveal controls that only show on hover (a delete button on an image, a menu that opens under the pointer). Pass its ref from browser_snapshot, or else the text it shows. Waits a moment for what the hover brings up, then returns a fresh snapshot, so what appeared has refs you can click. If a card or menu is still loading, take another browser_snapshot.

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot, e.g. e123.

tabId.description: Tab id from browser_open_tab or browser_list_tabs.

text.description: Instead of a ref: the visible text of the element to hover.

name: browser_hover
